readme.run: Reconstruct susceptibility maps from a BIDS dataset
notes: QSMbly's command line is QSMxT 9.22.0, the native build of the qsm-core
pipeline the web app runs. Use the processing command QSMbly
exports with qsmbly in place of qsmxt. Run qsmbly help for all commands, and
qsmbly dicom-convert DICOM_DIR BIDS_DIR to convert DICOM first.
Deep-learning weights are not included. Native compute verifies all 19
weights (1.7 GB) before starting, including for classical runs. Missing
files download from pinned URLs into ~/.cache/neurodesk/qsmbly/models.
Run qsmbly download-models before going offline. Set QSMBLY_OFFLINE=1 or
NEURODESK_OFFLINE=1 to require a complete verified local model pack.
Native examples use verified archives from a commit-pinned dataset mirror.
Offline mode disables example downloads; help and listing remain available.
Native slurm and tui bypass wrapper guards in scheduler jobs and are
unavailable. Write scheduler scripts invoking qsmbly run instead.
QSMxT is research software. Please cite: Stewart AW, Robinson SD, O'Brien K,
et al. QSMxT: Robust masking and artifact reduction for quantitative
susceptibility mapping. Magnetic Resonance in Medicine. 2022;87(3):1289-1300.
